items.title: Vedanta dividend alert! Last day to buy shares of Anil Agarwal-led company for Rs 5/share dividend
items.description: The company last week declared the interim dividend, which marks its first payout since the stock adjusted for its mega demerger earlier this year. The total dividend payout will be Rs 1,955 crore. Vedanta is closely watched by investors for its consistent track record of dividend payments.

items.title: TCS dividend alert! Last day to buy IT major's shares for Rs 12 dividend
items.description: The company last week declared the interim dividend, along with the Q2 results that kickstarted the September quarter earnings season for the IT sector. The latest dividend comes after TCS paid an interim dividend of Rs 12 per share to its shareholders in July.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 7 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, seven stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200-day moving averages (DMA) on October 12, 2026, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. The 200-day moving average (DMA) is used by traders as a key indicator for determining the overall trend of a stock. As long as a stock's price remains above its 200-day moving average on the daily timeframe, it is generally interpreted as being in an overall uptrend.

items.title: Bank of India declares Rs 575 crore exposure to Future Enterprises as fraud
items.description: The Bank of India has officially marked its ₹575 crore exposure to Future Enterprises as fraudulent. Previously categorized as a non-performing asset, this account has been sufficiently provisioned. Future Enterprises, helmed by Kishore Biyani, entered insolvency proceedings back in 2022, focusing on retail infrastructure development and managing a variety of subsidiaries and joint ventures across different sectors.

items.title: AMC stocks gain up to 33% in H1 FY27 despite market turmoil
items.description: Amid stock market fluctuations, listed asset management companies have successfully held their ground, thanks in part to robust retail investor support. Companies like Nippon Life India Asset Management recorded significant share price appreciation during the first half of FY27. Though SIP inflows dipped slightly from their peak levels, they retained a solid foundation, signaling ongoing investor confidence.

items.title: Sensex, Nifty fall 0.7% as oil surge erases early gains
items.description: On Monday, Indian equities dipped as crude oil prices surged dramatically after recent attacks on Saudi Arabia. The NSE Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex reversed their earlier positive trajectories, influenced by notable foreign selling. Additionally, worries over the rupee's stability and continual sell-offs from foreign investors decreased market optimism. A reported 1.2% rise in Brent crude intensified fears of potential supply interruptions.

items.title: Stocks in news: HCL Tech, RBL Bank, Nazara Tech, Hero Motors, Power Grid and IRCON
items.description: Indian stock markets struggled on Monday, as the Nifty 50 saw a considerable drop. The falls were attributed to increasing bond yields, consistent outflows from foreign institutional investors, and pervasive global concerns. Attention now shifts to forthcoming announcements from major players like HCL Technologies and RBL Bank, with quarterly earnings expected to influence investor outlook.

items.title: D-Street poised for positive start as GIFT Nifty signals gains
items.description: Benchmark Nifty encountered a decline of 0.7% on Monday, driven by growing geopolitical tensions. Market analysts foresee a cautious atmosphere in India, primarily due to volatile crude oil prices and the crisis in West Asia. Foreign portfolio investors exited the market, selling shares worth Rs 1,708 crore, whereas domestic institutional investors invested Rs 3,045 crore. The rupee's strength increased by 96 paise, marking its largest gain in six months.

items.title: IHC, First Abu Dhabi eye stake in Bandhan Bank promoter
items.description: Early investors GIC & IFC jointly hold 30% in Bandhan Financial Services (BFSL), keen to exit. PE funds tapped too to gauge strategic interest. BFSL, led by Bandhan founder Chandra Shekhar Ghosh, has been working with advisers Jefferies to find strategic investors for 25-32%.

items.title: Top 10 blue-chips’ share of India’s m-cap drops to lowest since 2017
items.description: India's top 10 listed blue-chip companies are experiencing a decline in market capitalisation share. This decline is attributed to sustained foreign portfolio investor selling and large-cap stock underperformance. The top 10 companies now account for around 17.65% of the total market capitalisation as of October 9. Despite this, domestic flows are supporting the broader market and smaller companies are outperforming large caps.

items.title: Stock Radar: South Indian Bank stock takes support above 20-DMA after hitting record highs in September; time to buy the dip?
items.description: South Indian Bank shares rebounded after testing their 20-day moving average, with technical indicators pointing to a positive trend. Choice Broking’s Kkunal V. Parar sees potential for the stock to move towards Rs 55–58, citing support near Rs 42, a rising channel pattern and positive momentum, while noting it remains below its 10-DMA.

items.title: Sunil Mittal gets highest French civilian award
items.description: The honour recognises Mittal's contributions to strengthening economic ties between France and India as well as his achievements in the telecommunications and digital infrastructure and satellite communications space.
